speaker: 智樹
jp: ニンフ、この五円玉の穴を目で追うんだ。\nほーら、お前はだんだん眠くなーる……
en: Nymph, follow the hole in this five-yen coin with your eyes. Theeere, you're getting sleepier and sleepier...

speaker: ニンフ
jp: 催眠術をかけられるとわかって、\n黙って従うわけないでしょ！
en: You think I'd just go along quietly when I know you're trying to hypnotize me?!

speaker: 智樹
jp: そ、そうだな……\nここは別のヤツをターゲットに……
en: Y-yeah, fair enough... Guess I'll pick someone else as my target...
